symbol_consistency: selected observations must retain the same SymbolIdentity field values as the exact parent observations and be an exact member of the supplied transport bundle
full_coverage_rule: at least one exact bar lies inside the inclusive UTC interval and the selected source dataset timestamp extent brackets both parent interval boundaries
partial_coverage_rule: at least one exact bar lies inside but the source timestamp extent does not bracket both boundaries
no_coverage_rule: no exact source bar timestamp lies inside the interval
partial_or_no_coverage_effect: infrastructure unresolved; no geometry, child candidate, or structural invalidity
